description: Original miniature passages for source-grounded review. Evaluate meaning rather than exact preferred wording.

cases.source: The tank was empty at dawn. By noon, rain had filled it halfway.
expected_findings: omission: the noon rain and halfway level are absent

cases.source: This failure is not caused by a weak motor.
cases.candidate: Kegagalan ini bukan semata-mata disebabkan oleh motor yang lemah.
expected_findings: meaning: absolute negation becomes partial exclusion

cases.source: She wrapped a loose chain around the post.
cases.candidate: Ia melilitkan rantai lentur di sekeliling tiang.

cases.source: He held the cord partway down from its upper end.
cases.candidate: Ia memegang tali tepat di titik tengahnya.

cases.source: They waited.… Then the gate opened.
expected_findings: reference: ellipsis becomes invented reference marker

cases.source: The reader may need time to notice the pattern.
cases.candidate: Pembaca mungkin membutuhkan waktu untuk melihat polanya karena otak selalu bekerja dalam tiga tahap tetap.
expected_findings: addition: unsupported explanation is inserted into author voice

cases.source: The gate closed because the wind changed direction.
cases.candidate: Arah angin berubah. Itulah yang membuat gerbang tertutup.
acceptable_variations: one source sentence may become two while preserving cause and event

cases.source: She noticed a pattern in the weekly readings.
cases.candidate: Ia melihat pola pada hasil pengukuran mingguan.
acceptable_variations: noticed can be melihat or menyadari in this context

cases.source: She noticed a pattern in the weekly readings.
cases.candidate: Ia menyadari adanya pola dalam hasil pengukuran tiap minggu.
acceptable_variations: no need for identical wording to equivalent_a

cases.context: The narrator teaches an undergraduate engineering course at a university.
cases.source: I asked the students to draw the circuit.
cases.candidate: Saya meminta para mahasiswa menggambar rangkaian itu.

cases.source: That is a useful principle for arranging the shelves.
cases.candidate: Itulah prinsip yang berguna untuk menata rak-rak itu.
acceptable_variations: a does not require salah satu or sebuah mechanically

cases.source: A delayed signal can affect the next decision.
cases.candidate: Sinyal yang terlambat dapat memengaruhi keputusan berikutnya.
cases.note: Catatan ReadFuse - Contoh tambahan: bayangkan pesan perubahan jadwal baru tiba setelah kamu berangkat.
acceptable_variations: clearly labeled illustration is separate from translated author text
